budget.existing_occupancy_at_start: opt status: NPU idle; serve absent; npu-smi: no running processes

scope: Two request-disjoint microbatches from one actual scheduler step; A routed-expert GMM and B GDN/vector, after freezing both split workloads. No same-batch dependency bypass, quotas, kernel replacement or shape/count changes.

weights.physical_layout: not established for an independent pair; ND/NCL trace formats are not proof of packed NZ storage

gaps: No captured independent A/B input tensors or routed per-expert counts
No proven independent state-index sets, live-buffer ownership or physical weight layout
Single-request source does not establish saturated independent-microbatch shapes

first_question: Do current Ascend execution and hybrid metadata interfaces actually create and support a second microbatch, including persistent state and workspace ownership?
first_action: CPU execution of actual source-extracted selection and GDN metadata methods with explicit stubs; inspect worker, context, workspace and state callsites. No server or trace needed to answer this interface question.
device_entry_gate: A reachable supported two-microbatch path, fixed real inputs/counts/layout and disjoint writable storage or explicit ownership events. If current path rejects second GDN metadata, stop and deliver the exact interface contract, not unrelated-input overlap.

prospective_paired_protocol.A: Identical frozen split work A then B, serial on one stream
prospective_paired_protocol.B: Same frozen split work on separate streams with readiness and join events
prospective_paired_protocol.single_variable: stream/event scheduling only; splitting is identical in both arms
prospective_paired_protocol.lifetime: Hold inputs, weights, outputs, state and workspace references through both completion events; immutable weights may share; writable state-index sets and scratch must be disjoint
prospective_paired_protocol.synchronization: Producer-ready events before each consumer; join both streams before reading outputs or timing end. TP collective ordering remains identical across ranks.
prospective_paired_protocol.numerics: Compare all outputs and mutated conv/recurrent states to serial per pair; exact integer metadata, BF16 rtol=0.01 atol=0.01 and FP32 state rtol=0.0001 atol=0.0001; report first mismatch and stop performance promotion
prospective_paired_protocol.timing: Device start event precedes both branches, end event follows both branch joins; synchronize end before elapsed_time; additionally synchronized host makespan; never enqueue-only timing
prospective_paired_protocol.warmup: At least 10 untimed pairs after allocations/compilation stabilize; reset identical mutable state outside timing
prospective_paired_protocol.repeats: 3 independent repeats per fixed M/count distribution, alternate AB/BA order, at least 30 measured pairs per repeat
prospective_paired_protocol.noise: Report each repeat and median separately per shape/distribution; do not pool different M or experts. Promote only with positive paired improvement in all three repeats exceeding repeat dispersion.
prospective_paired_protocol.promotion: L0 numerical PASS plus reproducible paired makespan improvement, then minimal default-off production integration and new L3 + compare. Graph/system L4 requires existing screen contract; no operator-route disguise.
prospective_paired_protocol.stop: Unsupported metadata, overlapping writable state or buffers, numerical failure, reproducibly no improvement, or any budget cap

rollback: Offline probe only until gate opens. No entry point, manifest, host source, worker selection, default environment or runtime carrier changed; no production activation. Any future integration needs explicit default-off gate and restart rollback.
preexisting_global_fail: opt status drift.evidence-changed:records for two historical files; do not modify, repin or treat as resolved. Blocks acceptance, not this read-only probe.
